profile.headline: Staff Software and Performance Engineer at Intel
profile.summary: Seasoned and versatile software engineer specializing in low-level systems design, with deep experience across the full stack, from firmware and hardware integration to high-level application development and HPC/AI runtime performance optimization. Proven technical leader who designs robust architectures, mentors engineers, and delivers reliable, customer-focused products that bridge hardware and software.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer & Systems Architect — HPC/AI Runtime Performance & Infrastructure
positions.description: OpenSHMEM performance optimization on HPC/AI clusters.

positions.title: Software Engineer: Exascale Middleware
positions.description:
Led team through release of the VTUNE Fabric Profiler.
OpenSHMEM performance optimizations.

positions.title: Senior System Design Engineer / Staff Embedded Software Engineer - Medical Devices
positions.description:
Platform architect.
Lead embedded design engineer for company's first GPU-based Ultrasound device.
R&D embedded software lead for next-gen+ ultrasound transducer.

positions.title: Staff Embedded & Platform Software Engineer - Medical Devices
positions.description:
Embedded team lead.
Embedded programming in C++ for DSPs, MCUs and ARM-based (Xilinx Zync) FPGAs.
Board-level debug.
Custom FPGA Win10 Device Drivers.
FDA/EU Medical Device Regulations.

positions.title: Staff Network Software Engineer
positions.description:
High Performance Computing Fabrics SW.
Linux device drivers.

positions.title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer - Mobile
positions.description:
Pre-silicon Android/Linux. 
Lead for Si power-ons and Android boot.
Linux device driver work for new devices.

positions.title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Power management R&D.
Firmware, drivers, pre-silicon emulation.
